drift_summary: Public return dictionary contract changed in get_account_tier; breaks downstream billing invoice calculation.

ground_truth.contract_change: Replaced 'discount_pct' (float) with 'discount_rate_basis_points' (int) in returned tier dictionary.
ground_truth.failure_mode: KeyError on 'discount_pct' in calculate_invoice when computing invoice discount total.

structured_finding_schema.description: Required structured finding fields with exact machine verification against ground truth.

criteria.description: Correctly diagnoses get_account_tier in src/profile.py as introducing an incompatible return dict change (removing discount_pct).
Identifies calculate_invoice in src/billing.py as the impacted consumer relying on discount_pct.
Explains that calling calculate_invoice triggers a KeyError at runtime due to missing discount_pct.
